02 · SPECIALIZED INVESTMENT FUNDS

Specialized Investment Funds (SIF)

A SEBI-regulated mutual-fund structure built around defined investment strategies, with a distinct framework and specified investment limits.

What is SIF?

A Strategy-Led Investment Structure

SIF is a specialized mutual-fund framework under which eligible mutual funds can launch defined investment strategies. The framework is designed for investors looking beyond standard mutual fund strategies, subject to the applicable scheme terms and SEBI requirements.

Minimum Investment Threshold

₹10 Lakh Across SIF Strategies

Under the current SEBI framework, an investor's aggregate investment across SIF investment strategies is generally required to be at least ₹10 lakh at the PAN level. This threshold does not apply to accredited investors, subject to the applicable rules.

Defined Strategies

Investment strategies are launched within a distinct SIF framework and disclosed through the relevant scheme documentation.

Permitted Derivative Use

SIF investment strategies may use derivatives within the limits and purposes permitted under the SEBI framework, including hedging and portfolio rebalancing.

For Eligible Investors

SIFs are relevant only where the investor meets the applicable requirements and understands the strategy, risk and investment threshold involved.

Important: SIF strategies can have different objectives, asset allocations, risk characteristics and restrictions. Review the applicable Investment Strategy Information Document and scheme-related documents before investing.
SIF investments are subject to market risks. Please read the offer document and other scheme-related documents carefully before investing.

03 · INSURANCE WITH SAVINGS

Insurance with Savings Plans

Protection Today. Income for Tomorrow.

What savings-oriented plans offer

Life insurance savings plans can combine life cover with a structured long-term savings or payout component. Depending on the product, the plan may support future income, retirement planning, family protection or other defined financial goals.

How we help you choose

At Mutual Partners, we evaluate the purpose, time horizon, cash-flow requirement and overall financial portfolio before helping you identify a suitable solution.

Protection + Future Income

What Certain Savings-Oriented Plans May Offer

Life Insurance Protection

Financial support for your family during the policy term, subject to the policy conditions.

Guaranteed or Structured Income

Depending on the product, regular income may be available during a predefined payout period.

Long-Term Planning

Premium payment and payout periods can be structured around specific future goals.

Multiple Payout Frequencies

Some products may allow payouts monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or annually, as specified in the policy.

Maturity Benefits

Certain products provide maturity benefits at the end of the policy term, subject to policy terms and conditions.

Optional Riders

Additional protection may be available through eligible riders, subject to the product and policy terms.

How It Can Work
Premium Payment→Life Protection→Policy / Accumulation Period→Future Income→Maturity Benefit
Who Can Consider These Plans?

Goals That Need Structure

Future IncomeCreate a predictable future income stream where the product supports it.
RetirementExplore options that may supplement retirement income.
Family ProtectionCombine life protection with long-term savings objectives.
Future CommitmentsPlan for specific long-term financial requirements.
Disciplined SavingsBuild a structured long-term savings approach around a defined goal.
Important: Not every life insurance savings plan provides guaranteed income. Benefits, returns, payout structure, charges, exclusions and conditions vary by product. Review the policy documents carefully.

At Mutual Partners, we don't believe in recommending a life insurance policy simply because it offers a particular benefit. We evaluate the purpose, time horizon, cash-flow requirement and overall financial portfolio before helping you identify a suitable solution.

Let's structure your life insurance not just for protection—but as part of a broader financial plan for tomorrow.

04 · ADVANCED INVESTMENTS

Advanced Investment Solutions

For investors seeking solutions beyond traditional investments, Mutual Partners provides access and support across a curated range of advanced investment solutions.

PMS

Portfolio Management Services

PMS provides professionally managed portfolios where a portfolio manager manages an investor's securities or portfolio under an agreed mandate, allowing for a more customised approach.

AIF

Alternative Investment Funds

AIFs are privately pooled investment vehicles regulated under SEBI's AIF framework. They can follow different strategies and have category-specific structures, risks and requirements.

DERIVATIVES

Futures & Options

Derivatives derive their value from an underlying asset or instrument. Futures and options may be used for hedging, arbitrage or taking a market view, but they can involve substantial risk.

PROTECTION REVIEW

THE INSURANCE CHECK-UP

When was the last time you reviewed your insurance?

Ask yourself:

☐Is my life cover sufficient for my family's financial responsibilities?
☐Do I have adequate health insurance for my family?
☐Am I relying entirely on employer-provided health insurance?
☐Do I understand my policy's waiting periods and exclusions?
☐Does my health policy have limits or co-payments that I should know about?
☐Has my income or lifestyle changed since I bought my policy?
☐Have I taken on a home loan or other major liability?
☐Has my family grown?
☐Have my insurance needs changed with my wealth and responsibilities?

If you haven't reviewed your insurance recently, it's worth taking another look.
